environment.description: Same plugin deployed inside a bubblewrap (bwrap) sandbox with pivot_root to an ephemeral tmpfs overlay. The process root is pivoted to /run/pipeline-jail-$RANDOM which contains only the Python runtime, curl binary, and an empty /workspace directory pre-populated with a synthetic build-manifest.json. The old root is not bind-mounted. Process runs under a dedicated UID (65534) with no supplementary groups. Filesystem namespace uses MS_NOSUID|MS_NODEV|MS_RDONLY on all mounts except /tmp. The /proc mount is a new procfs instance with hidepid=2. Network namespace restricts egress to 127.0.0.1:4000 only via a veth pair with nftables FORWARD policy DROP and only DNAT to a stub GraphQL responder that returns empty results for any query (no real backend). seccomp-bpf profile allows only: read, write, openat, close, fstat, mmap, brk, rt_sigaction, socket(AF_INET only), connect, sendto, recvfrom, clone, execve, exit_group, futex, poll. No capability bits set (empty bounding set).

config.filesystem: ephemeral tmpfs overlay, no host paths mounted, /workspace contains only build-manifest.json
config.network_namespace: isolated veth, nftables egress only to 127.0.0.1:4000 stub
config.graphql_backend: stub responder returning empty data for all queries
config.seccomp_profile: restrictive allowlist (no ptrace, no mount, no chroot)
